derive the reciprocal interval additive-energy bound from the incidence theorem, including zero-denominator and dyadic degeneracy exits

plain_conclusion: 当前唯一内部自足线又压窄了一层：RNRS/Rudnev 输入不再是泛称，而是精确卡在 Rudnev 点-平面 incidence 的作者侧自足证明。从该 incidence 定理到倒数区间能量、再到 RKS23 平衡颈部参数的接口已经闭合；但点-平面 incidence 的 polynomial-method/line-intersection 证明尚未并入，所以 row_column_unconditional_closed 仍必须保持 false。

point_plane_statement.ambient: projective or affine 3-space over F_P, P odd prime
point_plane_statement.degeneracy_parameter: k=maximal number of collinear points of R, equivalently maximal collinear/rich-line obstruction in the dual model
point_plane_statement.objects: point set R and plane set Pi

reciprocal_energy_reduction.closed_scope: conditional reduction from the corollary to the row/column energy input is closed
reciprocal_energy_reduction.incidence_role: after clearing denominators and dyadically separating degeneracies, the nondegenerate collisions are controlled by the point-plane bound; rich-line terms are measured by k
reciprocal_energy_reduction.not_closed_scope: the polynomial-method proof of the point-plane theorem is not yet included in the manuscript
reciprocal_energy_reduction.required_corollary: E_+(J^{-1}) <= C_E N^(5/2) P^eps for N in the square-root logarithmic collar
reciprocal_energy_reduction.set: J is an interval in F_P with |J|=N and B=J^{-1}
reciprocal_energy_reduction.target_absorption: N^(5/2)P^eps is N^(3-delta_E) after choosing eps smaller than the fixed collar margin, so it pays every fixed log loss

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把唯一内部自足剩余固定为 RNRS/Rudnev 倒数能量输入。
Rudnev 点-平面 incidence 的对象、规模条件和 k 退化项已登记成可审查接口。
一旦点-平面 incidence 可用，倒数区间能量推论足以回填当前 RKS23 颈部能量输入。
k 项被隔离为区间/rich-line 退化账本；它不允许回用已判定循环的 RKS23 链。
N≈P^(1/2)log^O(P) 下，N^(5/2)P^eps 形态给固定幂节省并吸收固定对数损失。
若接受外部 Rudnev/RNRS，则该输入可外部闭合。
作者侧尚未把 Rudnev/de Zeeuw 点-平面 incidence 证明完整内联。
严格内部自足版仍卡在点-平面 incidence 的自足证明，而不是卡在参数匹配。
本步只把剩余压成 incidence 证明原子；未宣称行/列命题无条件闭合。
